name: The Long Ear
description: Act 2, chapter `the-foundry`, optional (STORY.md §16): the `long-ear` mission on Teth. A pale icy moon; north of the Core a huge parabolic dish 124 u across sunk 22 u into the ice, with a flat hub at its focus (`dish-core`, guarded lightly by relic grid `ear`: a node and two sentinels) and three tuning plates on its rim at 120° (`ear-a` north, `ear-b` south-west, `ear-c` south-east): hold all three to tune it, which sets `long-ear` (in Covenant and Proof you can send your own report). No life, no packs (open spawn, 30 min grace). Still needs: a "hold three sites" objective, the dish as a structure, and the expedition package.

sites.label: The dish core: the Long Ear (talks to Sol)
